description:
This position is responsible for the development, packaging and support of Application Programming Interfaces and supporting Class Libraries to be used by the software development teams within the organization. The API Developer implements the model that conforms to the contextual domain architecture and governance needs of the organization. This position constructs software libraries at the enterprise level to meet the needs of the Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC). The position performs pragmatic and innovative solutions for use in multiple projects following the detailed design decisions of the Chief Architect.
 This position provides development, support and problem resolution directly associated with the projects assigned. In addition, this position participates in reviews of design specifications to adapt technical solutions to the AOC defined methodologies; participates and coordinates with other programmers and development teams to create efficient applications delivered within the constraints of a project plan; uses and employs best practices in technical solutions with enterprise domain objects as a focus. This position also creates and maintains code level technical documentation for developed and supported application components and supporting utilities; and works consistently within the established AOC-ITD procedures for problem, project, and change management processes. In addition, this position must interface and coordinate with internal/external agencies to ensure AOC-ITD standardization.

 Identification, definition, packaging and support of WCF services and supporting Domain Libraries to be used by the software development teams. Constructs software libraries at the enterprise level of use in multiple projects. Provides development, support and problem resolution; reviews of design specifications to adapt technical solutions; participates and coordinates with other programmers and development teams; creates and maintains code level technical documentation; interface and coordinate with internal/external agencies.
 MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: 

 Bachelor's degree in a related field and at least five years' experience programming, analysis, design, development, implementation, quality assurance and applications support. Directly related experience may substitute for the degree requirement. A thorough understanding and familiarity with REST, and Web API development using the .Net platform with VB.Net, C#, JSON and XML is required. This individual must be familiar with software development lifecycle methodologies (preferably CMMI); be experienced using source control and change management procedures; have a solid understanding of object oriented design concepts, separation of concerns, dependency injection; and a working technical knowledge of automated software development support tools. In addition, this individual should have significant experience with business to business integration using SOAP and REST, OWIN, JWT and OpenID Connect. The candidate will have knowledge of Domain Driven Development, Service and Resource Oriented Architectures, messaging strategies, event stores and an enterprise message queue. The preferred candidate will have five years' experience programming and producing enterprise level, service oriented distributed applications.
